column1: # SPEC §5.1 row 3 ("a counted array's count past its Max or below its Min")
# and §4.2 (a fresh value is born at its Min) on the Luau table runtime
# TestLuauCountBelowMinRefused. The reader declares [2..4], the writer [..4].
# Every read refuses a count below the reader's Min, as the Go engine refuses
# count_over_bound; every write refuses one; a new value holds Min elements.
# The lawful twin of every case reads or writes.
# form, and what the probe does with input:
#   born-var, born-fixed  the count of a new P (variable) or M (fixed) value
#   var-read      read wire (hex) as a variable P; input is the writer's
#                 value it encodes, JSON under writer/Probe.schema
#   json-read     read the JSON text as P
#   text-read     read the text form as P
#   var-write     save a P holding the items (space separated)
#   fixed-write   save an M row holding the items
#   fixed-read    load the lawful M image of the items 7 8 with its count
#   message-read  read wire (hex) as a batch of one M message under the
#                 writer's announcement; input is the writer's value
# wire: the committed bytes the writer's Go engine encodes for input (the
#       test re-encodes input and refuses a drifted fixture); - where unused.
